title: version
description: Which contract versions an app serves, in the one version answer every app gives, in every contract version (ADR-S03): a reader that was told unsupported_contract, or that meets an app for the first time, asks it and then asks again with a version both speak. The app, its build and the contract this answer is in are read from ran. It never refuses a contract: ran.contract is the asked version when the app serves it, otherwise the newest version it serves.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/contracts/version/v1: the one form of the version answer, the same for every app and every contract version, so a reader knows its shape whatever it asked for.

kind.description: Always Version, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

data.description: What the app serves; which app, which build and which contract this answer is in are in ran, never here.

supportedContracts.description: Every contract version the app serves, so a reader picks one it also speaks and asks again with it (ADR-S03, ADR-S06). It includes ran.contract; each app's tests check that.

items.description: One contract version the app serves, such as v1.
